title: ITR filing deadline in 2 days: Tax experts explain how you can file returns in just 10 minutes
text: The income tax return filing deadline is approaching, with only two days left. Tax experts explain how taxpayers can complete ITR filing quickly using the correct forms and documents, pre-filled data and e-verification before 31 July.

title: “I'll do it tomorrow” often turns into deadline-day panic, warns income tax dept ahead of 31 July ITR due date
text: With the July 31 deadline for income tax return filing nearing, the tax department urges taxpayers to file early to avoid last-minute stress and errors. Details here.

title: 8th Pay Commission not required to brief Centre during deliberations, Finance Ministry tells Rajya Sabha
text: The Finance Ministry has clarified in Parliament that the 8th Pay Commission is not required to share regular progress updates with the Centre. The Commission has autonomy, may determine its own procedures under the ToR, and will submit its final recommendations after 18 months, the minister said.

title: Why child-free couples may need more—not less—for retirement
text: Conventional wisdom says child-free couples need a smaller retirement corpus. In reality, longer retirements, caregiving costs and the absence of a family safety net can make financial planning more demanding.

title: Can you change the income tax regime while filing ITR? Here's what taxpayers should know
text: Salaried taxpayers can switch between the old and new tax regimes while filing their ITR, regardless of the regime used by their employer for TDS. However, rules differ for those with business income. Understanding the flexibility and tax impact can help taxpayers make an informed choice.

title: EPF Scheme 2026: Got married? Your past PF nomination is now invalid — key FAQs answered
text: Your earlier EPF nomination becomes invalid once you get married. Filing a fresh nomination ensures your PF benefits are paid to the intended beneficiaries without unnecessary delays or legal complications.

title: Multi-asset allocation funds lead hybrid category inflows: Why investors are rushing in and what to check
text: Multi-asset allocation funds topped the hybrid category, recording ₹70,819 crore in net inflows in 12 months. These funds help diversify across equities, debt, gold, and other assets. Investors should evaluate allocation strategy, diversification, and capture ratios before investing.

title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: ₹2,500 monthly assistance announced; Check eligibility, rules and documents
text: The Delhi government has launched the 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana', providing eligible women with monthly financial assistance of ₹2,500, of which ₹1,500 will go into a locked savings account. The initiative aims to empower women financially and support family stability.

title: I work remotely in India for a US firm. Can I avoid Indian tax if I'm paid in the US?
text: Many tech professionals moving back home assume receiving dollars in a foreign account keeps their income out of local jurisdiction—here is how tax residency rules actually treat global earnings.

title: Switched jobs and lost track of your old PF account? Govt explains how EPFO's e-portal can help
text: The government has revealed that the EPFO has developed an Aadhaar-based e-portal to help members trace old inoperative PF accounts, transfer balances to their active UAN or settle claims. The portal aims to reduce paperwork, improve transparency and simplify access to forgotten PF savings.

title: Vermont’s largest energy source is now a virtual power plant
text: Green Mountain Power’s virtual power plant (VPP) – the state’s largest energy source – cut an estimated $6 million from all customers’ peak electricity costs during Vermont’s early July heat wave.

title: Tesla self-driving manager describes scary conditions in robotaxi testing
text: A former Tesla manager who ran the company’s “Full Self-Driving” test fleet in Houston says the operation was so understaffed that its cars became “rolling hazards on public streets,” according to a lawsuit. The manager, Javier Medrano, filed the wrongful-termination complaint in Houston federal court, and its contents were reported this week. He oversaw the fleet before Tesla launched its driverless “Robotaxi” in the city.

title: You’ve heard of shared e-bikes. Now check out Veo’s new shared e-trike
text: If you’ve spent any time in a city with shared micromobility, you’ve probably seen fleets of rental e-bikes and e-scooters waiting on street corners. But one company is betting that the next evolution of shared transportation isn’t just another bike or scooter – it’s an electric trike.

title: Mercedes’ new GLA EV leaks a day ahead of its official debut
text: The GLA is the smallest, most affordable SUV Mercedes-Benz offers. Ahead of its debut on July 29, the first image of the all-new GLA EV leaked online.

title: Saudi Prince Alwaleed takes 5% Lucid (LCID) stake, stock jumps 25%
text: Saudi billionaire Prince Alwaleed bin Talal has disclosed a 5% stake in Lucid Group, and the market read it as a fresh vote of Saudi confidence in the cash-strapped EV maker. Lucid (LCID) shares jumped as much as 25% on Tuesday after the filing surfaced, even though the disclosure itself is passive and mostly a technical formality.

title: Baidu’s Apollo Go begins London robotaxi testing with Uber and Lyft
text: Baidu’s Apollo Go started robotaxi road testing in London today, and it’s doing it with both of ride-hailing’s biggest names at once — Uber and Freenow by Lyft. The launch lands days after Apollo Go ran the first fully driverless trial in any right-hand-drive market, in Hong Kong. Two milestones in one week, on opposite ends of the world.

title: Volkswagen launches the cheaper ID. Polo EV after securing 25,000 orders in weeks
text: Volkswagen opened pre-orders for the ID. Polo with the smaller 37 kWh battery, starting at under $30,000. The lower-priced model arrives after Volkswagen’s new EV received 25,000 orders weeks after it went on sale.

title: BMW ramps up iX3 output as orders near 100,000
text: The new BMW iX3 has already received nearly 100,000 orders. Now, BMW is ramping up production at a record pace to meet the strong demand.

title: Zcash says Ironwood proof rules out undetectable counterfeiting bugs
text: Zcash researchers published more than 2,700 machine-checked theorems designed to rule out undetectable counterfeiting bugs in Ironwood.

text: RL1 began operations as a member-owned blockchain cooperative backed by 10 European financial institutions, including ABN AMRO, DekaBank and Natixis CIB.

title: Myanmar parliament passes crypto scam bill with penalties up to life

title: The robot NASA hired to lift a orbital telescope tumbled out of control
text: According to NASA, two of the three reaction wheels that control the spacecraft's alignment have failed, and there are problems with one of the spacecraft's thruster systems.

title: Waymo, robotaxi operators face fresh scrutiny over emergency response failures
text: Rep. Kevin Mullin (D-California ) has proposed a bill that would direct federal regulators to establish minimum national safety standards for autonomous vehicle operators.

title: eBay reaches $56M settlement with e-commerce newsletter writers it terrorized in 2019
text: Ina and David Steiner inspired the ire of high-level eBay executives after occasionally criticizing the company in their newsletter. In 2019, a plot was concocted to intimidate the couple into halting their negative coverage.

title: These App Store hidden gems prove there’s still room for great software in the AI era
text: Despite predictions that AI agents could make traditional apps obsolete, developers are shipping new software faster than ever. From smarter bookmarking tools and neighborhood marketplaces to digital pen pals and nature journals, here are the latest App Store finds worth adding to your Home Screen.

title: HBO Max embraces vertical video with a new ‘Shorts’ feed
text: HBO Max, like other streaming platforms, is rethinking content discovery as large libraries are making it hard for viewers to find something to watch and as audiences become accustomed to short-form content on platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels.
